articles.title: Chapel Of Saint Peter / Atelier 66
english: The Chapel of Saint Peter, designed by Atelier 66, was completed in 2020 in Viana do Castelo, Portugal. It is a modern structure that blends with the coastal landscape, providing a tranquil space for reflection. The design emphasizes simplicity and harmony, inviting visitors to connect with nature as they approach the chapel.

Situated near the sea in Praia Norte, the chapel serves as a focal point within an urban park. The architects creatively integrated the chapel into the natural surroundings, enhancing the overall environment. This thoughtful approach showcases how architecture can complement nature and enrich community spaces.

The use of natural materials and light in the chapel’s design creates an inviting atmosphere. Large windows allow ample sunlight to illuminate the interior, fostering a serene ambiance. This project illustrates the potential of small-scale architecture to make significant impacts in public settings.
chinese: 聖彼得小教堂由Atelier 66設計，於2020年在葡萄牙維亞納·杜·卡斯特羅完工。這是一個現代結構，與海濱景觀融為一體，提供了一個靜謐的反思空間。設計強調簡約和和諧，邀請訪客在接近教堂時與自然連結。
這座小教堂位於Praia Norte海邊，成為城市公園中的焦點。建築師們靈活地將教堂融入自然環境中，增強了整體氛圍。這種深思熟慮的設計展示了建築如何與自然相輔相成，並豐富社區空間。
教堂設計中的天然材料和光線使用，創造了一個誘人的氛圍。大型窗戶讓充足的陽光照進室內，促進了寧靜的氛圍。這個項目展示了小規模建築在公共空間中可能產生的重大影響。

articles.title: STARTT opens up concealed ruins behind Pantheon in Rome
english: Italian architecture studio STARTT has introduced innovative micro-architectures that reveal an archaeological site previously hidden behind the Pantheon in Rome. The project, entitled Beyond the Pantheon, creates a public linkage between the iconic temple and the ruins of the Basilica of Neptune. This initiative not only opens these ancient ruins to visitors but also emphasizes the interconnectedness of historical urban spaces.

Initiated by the Italian Ministry of Culture, the project incorporates various steel and stone additions designed to enhance visitor experience. These micro-architectures serve multiple purposes, including restrooms and storage, effectively transforming the structural logistics while preserving the historical essence of the area. As described by STARTT's founder, these elements reorganize the site into a coherent navigational experience for its visitors.

The design features include dark steel panels that mimic the aesthetics of ancient ruins, reminiscent of mill scale from steel production. The careful consideration of materiality reflects a narrative of the archaeological stratification, moving from deep blacks at ground level to lighter blues, echoing the colors of the Roman sky. Such thoughtful design treatments contribute to both the functionality and storytelling of this unique archaeological endeavor.
chinese: 意大利建築工作室STARTT引入了創新的微型建築，揭示了過去隱藏在羅馬萬神殿背後的考古遺址。這個名為《萬神殿之後》的項目創造了一個公共連結，將這座標誌性的神廟與位於建築圓頂正後方的海神大教堂遺址相連。這一舉措不僅讓古老的遺跡向遊客打開大門，還強調了歷史城區空間的相互聯繫。
該項目由意大利文化部啟動，融入了多種鋼鐵和石材的附加元素，以提升遊客體驗。這些微型建築的功能多樣，包括衛生間和儲藏室，有效地改變了結構的後勤流程，同時保留了該地區的歷史精髓。STARTT的創始人描述道，這些元素將場地重新組合，為遊客提供了一個一致的導航體驗。
設計特徵包括模仿古老遺跡美學的深色鋼板，類似於鋼鐵生產中的鋼層。對材料性質的細心考量反映了一種考古分層的敘事，從地面深黑色向更淺的藍色過渡，呼應著羅馬天空的顏色。這樣周到的設計處理為這一獨特的考古事業增添了功能性和故事性。
